title: 黑道贩子 Shady Dealer
body:
**黑道贩子 Shady Dealer**
「Honest merchants are as rare as water.」

**前提条件：沙丘商人主题**

A merchant house has power and influence, soldiers and workers, but everything the house is depends on its representatives' efforts. The shady dealer represents one breed of dune trader, a skilled and treacherous agent specializing in intrigue and manipulation. Some shady dealers work as independent speculators and others act on a larger house's behalf. They still travel as dune traders, shepherding goods to places in need, but they always have an ulterior motive, seeking some rumor or bit of gossip to benefit themselves or their house.

The image you cultivate masks a devious mind and a propensity for doing whatever you must to survive. Your skills at negotiation and intrigue serve you well: they let you confuse enemies and lure them into traps where your allies can strike. In time, your words and movements make fools of everyone you meet.

**11级：诈骗行动 Swindling Action Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，此额外动作不会引发借机攻击。

**11级：精通旅行 Well Traveled**

**增益：**当你做一次唬骗，交涉或市井检定时，你掷骰两次并使用任一结果。

另外，选择两种语言。你能说，读和些这些语言。在21级时，你能再选择额外两种语言。

title: 黑石守卫 Blackstone Guardian
body:
**黑石守卫 Blackstone Guardian**
「I have peered into the darkness clouding my soul, and it has found me worthy.」

**前提条件：战魂**

Strange dreams are common among those who wield psionics. Your dreams, however, are different. You dream of a black monolith set within a cavern rimed with ice. This vision has haunted you for as long as you can remember, but until now, you have struggled in vain to discover its meaning.

The blackstone monolith has chosen you as its champion. In another age, noble champions of a distant land fought to contain a breach to the Far Realm. They sealed the rift with powerful psionic wards, behind elemental stone imbued with their own consciousness. Each generation, the wards they forged must be resealed by new champions. You are bound to the fate of the guardians you follow.

**11级：黑石行动 Blackstone Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来使用一个攻击威能时，你获得等同于3 + 你感知调整值的全伤害抗力，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：巨石之视 Monolithic Vision**

**增益：**每当你使用你的⟦精神之矛 Mind Spike⟧威能时，你同时滑动那威能的目标3格。然后目标迟缓直到它下一回合结束。

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Point**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：黑石诅咒 Blackstone Curse**

⟦黑石诅咒 Blackstone Curse⟧

**12级：巨石之赐 Monolithic Blessing**

⟦巨石之赐 Monolithic Blessing⟧

**16级：黑石锁链 Blackstone Chains**

**增益：**每当你将一个敌人的血量降至0时，每个被你标记的敌人定身直到你下一回合结束。

title: 黑曜石追踪者 Obsidian Stalker
body:
**黑曜石追踪者 Obsidian Stalker**
「高墙、守卫和野兽——这些都无法阻止我接近我的目标」

**前提条件：刺客**

你是一只捕猎中的幽灵，一名利用阴影魔法穿梭于最紧密防线的刺客。当你选择结束一个生命，没有阻碍能当在你的面前。

这种刺客传统起源于“黑曜石洞穴工会”，由一位先辈矮人领导，专长于追捕和杀戮幽暗地域的怪物。Initiates of the Obsidian Cave were tasked with finding and killing mind flayers, drow priestesses, and others that sought to attack the surface world. With such preventative attacks, the dwarves ensured that their mines remained safe. Since that time, the hunting phantom's techniques have passed to assassins from different traditions.

**11级：追踪者行动 Stalker's Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你同时获得相位移动并成为虚体直到你下一回合结束

**11级：追踪者形态 Stalker's Form**

**增益：**当处于虚体时，你在对抗借机攻击的所有防御上获得+5加值。同时，每日一次，当你使用⟦阴影形态 Shade Form⟧时，你获得相位移动直到你下一回合结束。

title: 虹吸 Siphon
body:
**虹吸 Siphon**
「你的恐惧，愤怒，希望和盟友都会被我吞噬。当你只剩下一具空壳，我的盛宴才会结束。」

**前提条件：炽念使**

Not all vampires are undead, drinking the blood of the living or draining souls with a touch. Some feast on intense feelings such as fear and love, anger and happiness. They are insidious creatures—parasites that gorge without drawing attention to themselves. Some might not even realize what they're doing. Regardless of whether a siphon is cognizant of his or her abilities, the effect of such a character's power is palpable, as a victim falls into the clutches of lethargy, becoming torpid and drained.

As a siphon, you use psionics to absorb thought energy from your victims, drinking deep from their emotions and feelings to increase your power. Your mind is a vortex, catching others' thoughts and using them to replenish your resources and overcome your injuries. Once you establish a link with another creature, you can draw its energy until your prey is drained and unable to act. You might keep this energy for yourself or transfer it to your allies so that they can share its benefits.

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：心灵吸血鬼 Psychic Vampire**

**增益：**当一个离你5格内的敌人生命值降至0，或被晕眩，震慑或虚弱时，如果你在你下一回合结束前使用⟦炽念汹涌 Ardent Surge⟧，则此威能的目标恢复等同于你感知调整值的额外生命值

title: 虎爪大师 Tiger Claw Master
body:
**虎爪大师 Tiger Claw Master**
「我是猎人。你是猎物。」

**前提条件：武僧**

The tiger claw style is an ancient, honored path. Its practitioners have incorporated techniques from different traditions, but the style retains a central feature: the tiger claw. A practitioner curls his or her fingers toward the palm to make a claw. Through iron discipline, the monk transforms each digit into a rigid talon capable of raking and rending.

Mastering tiger claw maneuvers builds your strength and hardiness, and your strikes shred enemies. You spring at your foes with astounding speed. With true mastery, you take on the characteristics of the celestial tiger. Coarse orange and white striped fur covers your body. Your hands become clawed paws and a tiger's visage replaces your features. With great green orbs for eyes and a mouth filled with sharp teeth, you embody the tiger claw style.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次冲锋攻击时，作为冲锋的一部分你移动等同于你速度 + 2的格数，你在此冲锋中的移动不会引发借机攻击，且你能重掷作为此冲锋一部分的一个攻击骰

**增益：**当你掷一个攻击骰时，你能在此掷骰上受到-2减值。如果此攻击命中并且你触发你的「疾风连击」威能，则此威能造成4点额外伤害

**增益：**当你使用你的回气时，你恢复等同于你力量调整值的额外生命值。另外，你的回气给所有防御提供的加值等同于2 + 你力量调整值

title: 护门者 Gatekeeper
body:
**护门者 Gatekeeper**
「Though the Living Gate from which you descend is destroyed, you retain a knack for guarding thresholds.」

**前提条件：魔晶人**

The Living Gate, the first best defense against the horror of the Far Realm, is gone, dissolved into thousands of disparate crystal shards. A disaster, certainly, but you are keenly aware of the upside; some of those shards make up your body and some quanta of the original animating consciousness of the Living Gate makes up your mind.

Aside from the obvious benefit of your own existence, it should also be clear that you are composed of the physical manifestation of a straightforward concept, which fundamentally is about controlling access through a threshold.

Whether others call a feature a gate, a door, or an entry doesn't matter; all that matters is that you can conceive of a particular area as a threshold. Once you've got that fixed in your mind, your body viscerally responds, granting you ever greater abilities to open or close a way, to monitor a passage, to ward off foes, and to keep your allies safe.

**11级：危险之阈 Dangerous Threshold**

**增益：**每当一个敌人离开一个邻近你的格子并且进入一个不邻近你的格子，此敌人向你提供战斗优势直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：护门者行动 Gatekeeper's Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来获得额外动作时，直到你下一回合结束，敌人将邻近你的格子视为困难地形。

title: 护门者秘法师 Gatekeeper Mystagogue
prerequisite: 任意原力职业，护门者组织成员
body:
**护门者秘法师 Gatekeeper Mystagogue**
「他们曾经蹂躏过我们的世界，但只要我一息尚存，他们就别想再次得逞。」

**前提条件：任意原力职业，护门者组织成员**

16000年前，德鲁伊成立了护门者组织。他们以全部热忱承担了守护这个世界不受在吉波尔的深渊中潜滋暗长的扭曲恐怖的侵害。虽然失败过，这些生物还是寻找突破现实世界的屏障，占领凡间的机会。护门者履行职责过程中只有一次失败。大约9000年前。异变魔逃出了Xoriat，疯狂国度位面。经过苦战，护门者以强大的封印禁锢了异变魔。但成员也所剩无几。在那之后，护门者重申了古老的誓言，继续警惕的的履行自己的职责。

作为一名护门者的秘法师，你守护着你先辈们设下的封印，并致力于对付异怪。为了履行职责，你不断旅行。因为异变魔和它们的卵无时无刻不在想要破坏封印。为了对抗他们，你以古老的技艺强化你的精神以抵抗它们的腐败力量和堕落影响。

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你获得20点心灵抗力直到你下一回合结束。另外，你和每个邻近你的盟友能对任何心灵效果做一次豁免检定

**11级：异界末日 Aberrant Bane**

**增益：**你的攻击在对重伤的异界生物时，掷出19-20即可造成重击。

**11级：自然平衡 Nature's Balance**

⟦自然平衡 Nature's Balance⟧

title: 幻影奸徒 Phantasmagoric Scoundrel
prerequisite: 在神秘上受训，在唬骗或贼活上受训
body:
**幻影奸徒 Phantasmagoric Scoundrel**
「不...说真的，看看你身后。」

**前提条件：在神秘上受训，在唬骗或贼活上受训**

对于一些人来说，单纯靠语言来说服和欺骗对方是完全不够的。他们想要直接欺骗对方的眼睛，而不仅仅是从耳朵出发；这些人想要找到更加可靠的方式来戏弄那些妨碍他们的人。

而其中的一些人，比如你，选择涉足魔法。无论是通过训练还是纯粹的天赋，你已经掌握了幻术的艺术，并且将其与你机敏的思维和锋锐的骗术向结合，打造出了完美的骗术。

**11级：致盲行动 Blinding Action**

**增益：**当你使用一个遭遇或每日威能命中一个向你提供战斗优势的目标时，你可以花费一个行动点使该目标目盲直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：战地幻术师 Combat Illusionist**

**增益：**你从任意职业选择并获得一个7级或更低级的奥术幻术遭遇攻击威能，你不能选择一个你已知的威能。在21级时，你可以从任意职业选择并获得一个13级或更低级的奥术幻术遭遇攻击威能替换此威能。

**11级：幻术专家 Expert Phantasmagorist**

**增益：**你能掌握并施展欺骗类仪式，如同你具有⟦仪式施法者 Ritual Caster⟧专长一般。另外，每天一次，你能施展一个等级低于或等于你的欺骗类仪式而不需要花费材料（不过你仍然必须使用任何此仪式要求的器材）。

title: 幻影守卫 Phantasm Guard
body:
**幻影守卫 Phantasm Guard**
「You think you've faced your worst nightmare? Sorry, that's coming up next.」

**前提条件：侏儒，剑法师**

Gnomes are known for their prowess with illusions, but many outsiders believe such magic is employed merely for hiding and deception. To the gnomes, though, illusions are much more. They serve as a great equalizer, which they use to attack as well as protect. They can assault the minds of foes directly using well-crafted figments and phantasmal perceptions, which are effective regardless of the physical attributes of those involved.

Your race's natural talent for illusions combines with carefully honed swordmage techniques, creating the path of the phantasm guard. Using your magic, you assail the minds of your foes, and punish those who seek to harm your companions by revealing to them glimpses of their worst nightmares and disguising the true nature of threats.

Phantasm guards are often outwardly charming and compassionate gnomes, expressing a keen understanding of and sympathy for their fellow beings. As one, you act as a trustworthy confidant who is concerned with the plights of others. Frequently interested with exploring the meaning of "truth", you might engage in philosophical discussions with others to pass the time. However, the purpose of such kindness is just as often more cynical: the goal being to gain and exploit knowledge of potential adversaries so that you can better and more completely defeat your adversaries' minds if and when the time comes.

**11级：阴影庇护 Shadowed Aegis**

**增益：**你的那些对被你标记的敌人有隐蔽的盟友，改为具有全隐蔽

title: 唤石者 Stonecaller
body:
**唤石者 Stonecaller**
「世界上的岩石都铭记着过去的错误。暗怒隐匿在石头里。」

**前提条件：神导士**

古老的造物语言被锁在地球的骨骼中。你已经掌握了这门语言中一些最古老、最基本的音节，这些音节如此洪亮，几乎连凡人都说不出来。用你的语言和你的意志，你可以唤醒世界上的每一块石头，让它给你力量，或者向你的敌人猛烈抨击。

矮人是最早的唤石者，但这一传统后来传播到了其他种族，尤其是歌利亚斯、半兽化人和野蛮人——他们生活在自然环境中。全世界的山民都知道来自唤石者声音的力量。

title: 荒漠之声 Desert's Voice
body:
**荒漠之声 Desert's Voice**
「There are voices in the land. I can hear their cries in the wind and in the shifting dunes. They call to me, begging for vengeance. Have I any choice but to answer?」

**前提条件：元素裔**

Your purpose has become clear. You see it in the desolation around you, in the ruins scattered across the countryside, in every agonized face you behold. The wind carries it with the stench of carrion, smoke, and fire. The ashes left by defilers, the bone fields that mark the places where tribes, cities or entire races were wiped out—these signs have revealed to you your reason for being: to repair the world. Perhaps the pull you feel is in your head, a delusion born from desperation. Do you dare ignore it? If the despoilers aren't stopped, what future does this world have? So you take upon yourself a dread task to undo the damage done to this world.

**11级：阿塔斯图腾 Athasian Totem**

You construct a special totem to serve as a focus and inspiration for your crusade. The item's presence is both a comfort and an assurance that you cannot fail.

**增益：**你获得图腾的法器擅长。另外，在你以一次使用图腾的法器攻击造成重击后，你能以一个自由动作快步1格。

**11级：沙漠显能 Desert Manifestation**

Your kinship with the wastelands awakens your elemental nature, making it easier for you to call upon your natural talents and to unlock new abilities you never knew you had.

**增益：**选择一个你未拥有的元素裔种族威能，此威能必须和灰烬，岩浆，流砂或皓日显能关联。你获得此威能。

**11级：废土行动 Wasteland Action**

When your need is greatest, the world answers. Your extra effort summons up shrieking winds to hammer your enemies.

**11级：毁灭之怒 Wrath of the Ravaged**

The world's broken and tattered spirit dances around you, waiting for your permission to unleash its wrath on the creatures it hates.

⟦毁灭之怒 Wrath of the Ravaged⟧

**12级：元素复原 Elemental Resurgence**

The wastes are rich with elemental energy. You can call upon it to give you new strength and resolve.

⟦元素复原 Elemental Resurgence⟧

**16级：元素专家 Elemental Adept**

Your elemental manifestation grows in intensity, building inside you and letting you achieve greater results when you call on its power.

**增益：**你在每个你拥有的元素裔种族威能上获得相关联的增益。

⟦灰烬之遁 Ashfall Evasion⟧：此威能变成近程爆发3

⟦震撼大地 Earthshock⟧：被此威能命中的生物不能起身直到你下一回合结束

⟦炽焰脉冲 Firepulse⟧：如果命中，每个邻近目标的敌人受到等同于你力量，体质或敏捷调整值的火焰伤害

⟦流体岩浆 Flowing Magma⟧：此威能不再使你迟缓

The desert's power is yours to command. When you use cataclysm, vengeful spirits boil out from the land, trailing elemental energy that rips your enemies to pieces.

title: 荒野奔者 Wildrunner
body:
**荒野奔者 Wildrunner**
「大地使我足下生翼，使我灵魂翱翔。」

**前提条件：野蛮人，在自然上受训**

野外是你的家，与大地的自然精魂的联系赐予你速度和狂野。你如同鹿一般穿过丛林，以猎豹的速度和凶猛冲入战斗。

荒野奔者的威能强调机动性，使你在打击敌人的时候快步或是迅速移动。你从一个敌人猛扑向另一个敌人，避免在狂暴引发的对敌伤害中被借机攻击。

精灵野蛮人大都踏入此典范之道，因为这些威能与他们天生的机动性互补。同样的，许多通过野蛮人兼职专长而培养出与自然之力联系的游侠也会发觉此道路的魅力。

**11级：猎手狂野 Hunter's Fury**

**11级：荒野奔者迅速 Wildrunner's Swiftness**

title: 黄昏鬼魂 Ghost of Eventide
prerequisite: 游荡者，来自于科米尔（Cormyr），谷地（the Dalelands），埃尔图加德（Elturgard），艾弗瑞斯卡（Evereska），灰谷（Gray Vale），拉露亚（Luruar）或桑比亚（Sembia）
body:
**黄昏鬼魂 Ghost of Eventide**
「Netheril means to enslave us. I have something to say about that. I think I'll let my blade do the talking.」

**前提条件：游荡者，来自于科米尔（Cormyr），谷地（the Dalelands），埃尔图加德（Elturgard），艾弗瑞斯卡（Evereska），灰谷（Gray Vale），拉露亚（Luruar）或桑比亚（Sembia）**

You thrive in the time between sundown and night. The shadows of twilight are all that keep you alive. They are a shroud even the Shadovar cannot pierce, from which you strike at their foul hearts. And long before the Netherese can find you, you've returned to the twilight shroud.

You are a silent blade in the mists, a trained killer whose skill at stealth foils even those foes who live in shadow and illusion. You are a ghost of eventide, a vengeful spirit fighting against an ancient foe whose tyranny has long laid a crushing yoke upon your race. It is only through wit, skill, and perseverance that anyone could survive against such dread foes. You repay their evil with death, and your training makes you the very best and bravest of any knife-wielding rogue or shadow warrior. You live on the knife's edge, tempting fate and inviting the wrath of some of the most powerful and vile enemies in all of Toril.

**11级：暗影动作 Shadowed Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你同时被阴影笼罩，获得隐蔽直到你下一回合开始。

**11级：暮光精准 Twilight Accuracy**

**增益：**你对拥有隐蔽的目标的近战攻击的攻击骰不会受到通常的-2减值。

**20级：身披暗影 Robed in Shadow**

title: 黄昏贤者 Dusk Oracle
body:
**黄昏贤者 Dusk Oracle**

**前提条件：在洞察和宗教上受训**

The spirits of the dead hold the accumulated lore of all creatures that once lived. Through the art of the dusk oracle, you have learned to call forth the ephemeral shades of the dead to answer questions and help you battle your foes. Whether you are a character capable of tapping into these endless memories or an empathic mortal called upon by the gods, your search for knowledge is guided by the whispers of the dead.

**11级：贤者洞察 Oracle's Insight**

You question the deceased, gaining insight into their memories. Faint spirits whisper directions and instructions to guide you toward your goals.

**增益：**你可以询问任何智慧生物的尸体一个问题且得到回答。尸体只知道它生前了解的以及其尸体所在地附近的事情。尸体会如实回答，不过有时候比较隐晦

**11级：预测行动 Predicted Action**

As you push yourself to the limit, you call on the spirits of the dead to correct your aim or to point out weaknesses in your opponent's defenses. At times, you can share these insights with an ally.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，此攻击对抗每个目标的强韧，反射或意志中最低那项。若你花费一个行动点来进行一个给予一个盟友一次攻击的动作，则你能将此增益应用于该盟友，而不是你自己

**11级：预知命中 Foreseen Hit**

In the heat of combat, you listen to the shades surrounding you and use their expertise to your advantage.

⟦预知命中 Foreseen Hit⟧

**12级：预见结果 Predicted Outcome**

You augment your own knowledge by drawing on the shadowy memories of the dead, seeking ancient wisdom and insight to guide your actions.

⟦预见结果 Predicted Outcome⟧

**16级：神谕洞察 Oracular Insight**

When your opponent's guard is down, the whispering spirits you summon allow you to bypass the enemy's defenses with expert accuracy.

**增益：**当你对一个敌人有战斗优势时，它具有的对抗你的攻击的任何抗力减少10点

Having earned the trust and respect of your spirit guides, you can call upon them to fight at your side.

⟦预知战斗 Foreseen Battle⟧

title: 灰卫 Gray Guard
prerequisite: 圣武士，在洞察和威吓上受训
body:
**灰卫 Gray Guard**
「不择手段完成任务，道德问题之后再想吧。」

**前提条件：圣武士，在洞察和威吓上受训**

As a paladin, you cleave to principles that guide you through life, shaping your worldview and forming your moral foundation. Even if you don't follow a code of behavior, you follow the precepts of your god and work to live up to your faith's expectations. Yet the enemy never plays fair. Sometimes rules must be bent, or even broken, for the greater good.

No one knows this better than you, a gray guard. You have made a career of defying expectations and making the tough choices that your peers avoid. For you, the ends justify the means—even stealing, lying, or brutal interrogation. You do what you must to defeat the enemy. Your tactics don't make you popular with others in service to your god. Many see you as dangerous, almost as much of a threat as your enemies. Let them say what they will. You know that, deep down, they fear you and might even respect you.

As you continue down this path, you might feel estranged from your god, a disappointment to the one for whom you have sacrificed so much. The blood staining your hands has somehow darkened your soul, although your abilities are unaffected. But you do what you must.

title: 辉煌大蛇 Radiant Serpent
body:
**辉煌大蛇 Radiant Serpent**
「羽蛇的精魂熠熠生辉。」

**前提条件：守望者**

You raise your eyes and heart to the stars and to the spirit of the shining, winged serpents that helped tame the primordials. You have chosen the couatl as a spiritual ally, embracing that legendary creature's power so thoroughly that you assume its very form. You emulate your shining ally by rising above the battle with a flourish of power or by passing through your enemies like a radiant spirit.

Like couatls, you understand the necessity of sacrifice. The coils of your power can trap enemies that would otherwise harm your allies, but you must be willing to take those allies' hurts on yourself. If your own survival is jeopardized as you protect your friends, so be it.

title: 毁灭之主 Doomlord
prerequisite: 精铸钢铁主题，或擅长鳞甲和一件军用近战武器
body:
**毁灭之主 Doomlord**

**前提条件：精铸钢铁主题，或擅长鳞甲和一件军用近战武器**

From brooding fortresses in the Elemental Chaos, the Doomguard watches the decay of the cosmos and its unstoppable slide into dissolution. These stoic warriors believe the universe’s fate was sealed when the gods defeated the primordials, because imprisoning these entities kept them from sustaining the world and thus doomed it. The Doomlords are the Doomguard‘s champions, warriors aligned against those who espouse order and perpetuate corrupt and tyrannical regimes. As is true of their cousins, the Doomguard Marauders (Manual of the Planes), the ranks of the Doomlords include both valiant champions of freedom and murderous anarchists.

**11级：毁灭之主行动 Doomlord's Action**

Channeling entropic forces causes reality to bend and groan around you until everything blackens and crumbles away around you.

**增益：**你可以花费一个行动点来对每个邻近你的生物造成1d10 + 你最高的属性调整值的暗蚀伤害，而不是进行额外动作。每个因此方式受到伤害的生物获得5点暗蚀易伤，直到你下一回合结束

**11级：熵能汹涌 Entropic Surge**

Rather than fully restore your vigor, you can channel some of your innate healing energy and release it in the form of wrath. For a few moments, you attacks fall with incredible accuracy.

**增益：**当你花费一次回复力来恢复生命值时，你可以选择将恢复的生命值减少等同于一半你回复力值的数值，来在攻击骰上获得+2加值直到你下一回合结束

**11级：熵能打击 Entropy Strike**

Your weapon is a tool of entropy. With the aid of this power, your strikes undo the work of creation, one enemy at a time.

⟦熵能打击 Entropy Strike⟧

Entropy can cause reality to splinter or break apart. You sense the cracks around you and leap through them to ambush your foes.

⟦毁灭之主推进 Doomlord's Advance⟧

The more creatures you defeat, the more the cosmos withers. Your destructive nature manifests as a field that prevents creatures from staving off death.

⟦熵能先兆 Entropic Harbinger⟧

**20级：加速终焉 Hasten the End**

The ultimate expression of your power is the ability to dissolve the bonds that hold an enemy together. A successful strike causes your opponent to degenerate until nothing but dust remains.

⟦加速终焉 Hasten the End⟧

title: 混乱代言者 Speaker of Xaos
body:
**混乱代言者 Speaker of Xaos**

**前提条件：在神秘上受训**

The Speakers of Xaos are a society of sages, wizards, explorers, and priests who study the Elemental Chaos. You are a member in good standing of this fellowship. The Speakers maintain libraries, small colleges, and chapter houses in many elemental domains, including the City of Brass and Zerthadlun, and the organization has small chapters in various mortal worlds as well.

The Speakers have no great purpose beyond a shared interest in the magic, secrets, and phenomena of the Elemental Chaos. Members report interesting discoveries to their fellows, consult with each other on difficult problems, and work together to collect and preserve unusual knowledge or resources pertaining to the Plane Below. Individual members are also free to follow their own desires regarding whether to share information or respond to calls for assistance from their fellows. The only rule is to treat your colleagues as you would have them treat you.

**11级：混乱学识 Xaos Lore**

You hold potent secrets of elemental spellcasting; your elemental spells and abilities are especially pernicious and long-lasting.

**增益：**你在对具有元素界起源的生物的攻击骰上获得+1加值，且这些生物在对抗由你创造的效果的豁免骰上受到-1减值

You command elemental powers with surprising deftness and flexibility, especially when you are under duress.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在你下一回合结束前，你可以拓宽你下一次寒冰，火焰，闪电或雷鸣攻击的效果。选择使一次近战或远程攻击增加一个射程内的目标，或使一个爆发或冲击的范围增加1

After calling upon a power that makes use of elemental energy, you can retain an echo or remnant of that energy. This power allows you to shape that remnant into a cage of blazing fire, bitter cold, or crackling lightning.

⟦元素禁锢 Elemental Durance⟧

**12级：排斥元素 Repel Elements**

Your understanding of the essential nature of elemental creatures and energies provides you with the power to hold them at bay when you wish.

⟦排斥元素 Repel Elements⟧

**16级：混乱之力 Power of Xaos**

You are so skilled in wielding elemental force that your successful attacks always inflict a significant amount of harm.

**增益：**当你以寒冰，火焰，闪电，雷鸣，或元素攻击造成伤害时，重掷任何结果为1的伤害骰子，直到结果为2或更高

**20级：元素锁链 Elemental Chains**

You are a master at shaping elemental energy. With this power, you can transform your elemental magic into damaging bonds, pinning your enemies in place.

When the fury is upon them, their bodies erupt in brilliant flames, obscuring their forms and scorching their enemies. Few forgeborn dwarves endure these transformations. title: 火眉指挥官 Flamebrow Commander
prerequisite: 督军，「勇猛风采」职业特性
body:
**火眉指挥官 Flamebrow Commander**
「Like Bergrom Earthfast, I endure.」

**前提条件：督军，「勇猛风采」职业特性**

A dragon driven to wrath is a terrifying foe. It stops at nothing to quench its fury in the blood of those who wronged it. Only the desire to protect its young can drive a dragon to even greater heights of recklessness. A dragonborn warrior is little different, and a dragonborn officer displays parental loyalty to those alongside whom he fights. Such is the dragonborn warrior ideal.

An exemplar of this standard was Dhuryan Flamebrow, an audacious but beloved dragonborn mercenary from the fringes of the empire of Arkhosia. Dhuryan was noble born, but upon him fell the consequences of his father's dark deeds. Without title or property in the empire, and living under the shadow of family history, he made his way as a soldier and leader. He made a habit of leading from the front with a brashness born of being indifferent to death. Glory and the erasing of the past was his overriding aim, yet he was unwilling to sacrifice his fellow fighters for his own gain.

Dhuryan succeeded in reshaping the armies of a border province known for its barbarism and monster problems. Eventually, that province and its dragon lord became the most prominent in Arkhosia, although only Dhuryan's name is widely remembered to this day. At long last, Dhuryan had cleansed his family name. He rose then to prominence as a military advisor and became a general in the wars that eventually destroyed Arkhosia. During this time, he penned the military manifesto titled Flamebrow, in honor of his clan. Myths from many cultures say that Dhuryan fought in numerous wars in this world and beyond, and that he fell but returned to life more than once. Tales say that he stands now beyond the touch of time, alongside other legendary generals, awaiting the world's need.

Flamebrow still exists, copied into many languages. It is a treatise for the commander who wishes to defeat enemies head-on. Although it speaks of deceptive planning and long-term strategies, it also talks of brutal efficiency and courageous leadership when battle is joined.

Whether through influence, reading and practice, or direct training, your path has been influenced by Flamebrow. Boldness of action fails to fully describe your methods. You act decisively, willing to lay your own survival on the line to get the job done and protect your allies.

**11级：不懈行动 Relentless Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你可以把你的「勇猛风采」职业特性用在自己身上就如同把自己视作自己的盟友。

body:
**机关金刚 Warforged Juggernaut**
「闪一边去，肉球！」

**前提条件：机关人**

你倾力于将自己打造成完美的机体——成为力量与勇猛的化身。也许你在终末战争中战斗在第一线，也许诞生于和平年代并且渴望体验你的军人本色。不管是哪种情况，你都尽情享受冲入敌群之中，把他们打得屁滚尿流的快感。作为一个机关金刚，你是无可阻挡的战力，身处战场，为群敌所环绕，你才能体会“家”的感觉。当你要坚守阵地的时候，你岿然不动。你的训练和构造使你能轻松承受足以将你的伙伴碾碎的攻击。

**11级：冲锋行动 Charging Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行冲锋攻击时，你在速度和所有防御上获得+2加值，直到你下一回合结束。另外，你在冲锋后可以继续进行更多动作

**11级：冲锋打击 Charging Strike**

**增益：**当你冲锋一个目标且命中它时，你的攻击对它造成1d6额外伤害，且你推离它1格。另外，你可以快步1格到目标空出的空间。21级时，此额外伤害为2d6

**11级：毁灭猛击 Ruinous Onslaught**

⟦毁灭猛击 Ruinous Onslaught⟧

**12级：无情推进 Inexorable Momentum**

⟦无情推进 Inexorable Momentum⟧

**16级：完美构装 Construct Perfection**

**增益：**你在豁免骰和坚韧检定上获得+2加值

**16级：不可阻挡 Unstoppable**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点时，你可以做一次豁免检定

**20级：钢铁峭壁 Crag of Steel**

⟦钢铁峭壁 Crag of Steel⟧

title: 机关人生命探索者 Warforged Lifeseeker
body:
**机关人生命探索者 Warforged Lifeseeker**
「I embrace life, living as an example to others.」

**前提条件：机关人，领导者职位**

You value the unique living aspect of your nature so highly, and study what it means to be alive so deeply, that you have become an expert on these subjects. Embracing your emotions and the needs of living, as well as those of others, you grow to understand life better than those who take it for granted. These insights work through your magical being, making you a better leader and healer.

**11级：医疗行动 Healing Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你或一个可以看见你的盟友恢复等同于你感知或魅力调整值中更高者的生命值。

**11级：社交专家 Social Savant**

**增益：**你在基于感知和基于魅力的技能和检定上获得+1加值。

**11级：气魄之击 Verve Strike**

⟦气魄之击 Verve Strike⟧

**12级：移情共振 Empathic Resonance**

⟦移情共振 Empathic Resonance⟧

**16级：移情链接 Empathic Bond**

**增益：**任何时候你使用一个威能来医疗一个盟友，你同时恢复等同于你感知或魅力调整值中更高者的生命值。

**20级：释放活力 Unleashed Vigor**

⟦释放活力 Unleashed Vigor⟧

title: 机敏探险家 Adroit Explorer
body:
**机敏探险家 Adroit Explorer**
「你让我们趁现在就回来？可是我们还不知道下一层楼有什么东西呢！」

**前提条件：人类**

未知世界对你有着无可名状的吸引力。你最大的愿望是探索和发现。你完美地诠释了人类那种为知识与力量寻遍世界的天性。你有一种近乎超人的决心，这种决心来自于你的本性――它驱使你更努力地工作，更执著于战斗，乃至于去完成超越自身实力的目标。如果你不是挖掘全力去战斗，你会感觉到胜利并不完美，目标还未完成。当你越是身陷绝境，你的意志就越发坚强。你只会更加努力地战斗，并确信自己终将获得胜利。

无论你是什么动机：寻求古老的文明，渴望遗失了的奥法力量，以埃拉西斯的名义去征服自然、散播文明，亦或是贪图金钱和荣誉，但为了达成目标你不惜面对巨大的危险。凭借着专心致志，你通常能从危险中全身而退――哪怕是死里逃生。

**11级：壮志雄心 Ambitious Effort**

**增益：**从你的职业中选择一个7级或更低的遭遇攻击威能。你获得该威能。如果你选择了一个你已知的遭遇攻击威能，则你可以在每场遭遇中使用该威能两次。21级时，你可以将该威能替换成一个13级或更低的你的职业中的遭遇攻击威能。

**11级：浴血决心 Bloody Determination**

**增益：**当你在遭遇中第一次重伤时，在你下一回合结束前，你在下一次对重伤你的该敌人的攻击骰上获得+5威能加值

**11级：英勇行动 Heroic Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你同时获得10点全伤害抗力，直到你下一回合结束。21级时，此抗力为20点。

**12级：命运非凡 Destined for Greatness**

⟦命运非凡 Destined for Greatness⟧

**16级：人类勇士 Champion of Humanity**

**增益：**在进行一次长休息后，你获得2个行动点，而不是1个。

**20级：浴血反击 Bloodied Greatness**

⟦浴血反击 Bloodied Greatness⟧

title: 机械工程师 Clockwork Engineer
body:
**机械工程师 Clockwork Engineer**
「我的朋友都是我造出来的，这算是……小爱好……吧。」

**前提条件：机关术士**

终末战争中，人们见证了机关术无与伦比的发展与进步。在促成机关人与其他完美战争机器的诞生时，机关术士们更进一步的理解了如何将科技与魔法融合起来。尽管多数机关术士都有着制造魔法仆役的习惯，但机械工程师将这一范畴上升到了艺术的高度。

机械工程师乃是利用非活化的物体创造拟态生命形式的专家。你只需片刻就能拼装出一个机械生物。你所创造出来的机械生物也非常坚固，活化时间长，并且比其他机关术士同仁们的造物更加完美。

你通过制造仆役，以及固有的机关术本领来协助队友作战，不过你可能感觉自己创造出来的小机械体比起冒险伙伴们来说还要更亲密一些。你可能极度溺爱你的造物，如果它们被摧毁，你会沉重地悼念它们，甚至为它们复仇。

在战斗之外，你身边总是围着一大圈人畜无害的机械工学造物。它们在你身边叽叽喳喳，扑腾来扑腾去，颇为有趣。许多机械工学造物都能帮你不少忙，甚至还是你的工程助手，有了它们帮助，你可以更快更轻松地创造出其它机械造物。

**11级：协调行动 Coordinated Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你同时获得2个次要动作，但它们只能用来命令你的召唤生物

**11级：持久技巧 Durable Artifice**

**增益：**你以机关术士或机械工程师威能召唤的生物在所有防御上获得+2威能加值

**11级：机械士兵 Clockwork Soldiers**

⟦机械士兵 Clockwork Soldiers⟧

**12级：援助技艺 Aid Artifice**

⟦援助技艺 Aid Artifice⟧

**16级：优异仆从 Superior Minions**

**增益：**你以机关术士或机械工程师威能召唤的生物在速度上获得+2加值，且在攻击骰上获得+1加值

**20级：机械伙伴 Clockwork Companion**

⟦机械伙伴 Clockwork Companion⟧

title: 机运编织者 Weaver of Chance
body:
**机运编织者 Weaver of Chance**
「没有什么伟大的计划和更高的目标，一切皆为偶然。」

**前提条件：法师**

你领会了宇宙的本质，是一个疯神玩耍、原始翻腾的毫无意义的地方，只有法师能够成为它们的标志。你理解了世界和它的共存位面并不是刻意设计而成的，而是经过无数年代的缓慢迭代的过程。

在宇宙中，诸神们控制着灵魂们的命运。这些命运交织着宿命的轨迹，呈现出包罗万象的法则。很少有人认同你的这种哲学理论，其中的一些人甚至可能以为你疯了。但你并不对终极意义或最终目标存在幻想，你的品行更加纯净：你的善行并不是因为遵循法典或追寻一些更伟大的目标，而是因为这是你自己的选择。

**11级：熵能引导 Channel Entropy**

**增益：**你可以存储和引导围绕你的熵能流动，这些勉强被控制的混沌用熵能池中的熵能点来表示。在一个短时休息或长时休息后，你的熵能池有0个熵能点。当你在任何d20掷骰上掷出20时，你的熵能池增加1个熵能点。当你在任何d20掷骰上掷出1时，你的熵能池减少1熵能点（最小为0）。

每轮一次，当你投掷一个d20并对结果不满意时，你可以从你的熵能池中消耗任意数量的熵能点，每消耗1个熵能点，投掷结果+1。如果你在你回合开始后消耗了熵能点，那么你不能再消耗熵能点直到你下一回合开始。

**11级：熵能行动 Entropic Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你可以掷一个d6。若结果为偶数，则在你的熵能池中增加等同于掷骰结果的熵能点，同时你传送等同于掷骰结果的格数。若掷骰结果为奇数，则在你的熵能池中减少等同于掷骰结果的熵能点（最小值0），同时把一个离你5格内的敌人传送等同于掷骰结果的格数。

**11级：熵能重组 Entropic Reshuffling**

⟦熵能重组 Entropic Reshuffling⟧

**12级：机运代理 Agency of Chance**

⟦机运代理 Agency of Chance⟧

**16级：几率博弈 Play the Odds**

**增益：**每场遭遇一次，在你使用一个奥术攻击威能进行攻击检定之前，你能以一个自由动作掷一个d6并把结果增加到此攻击检定上。若此攻击命中，则造成2d6额外伤害，同时在你的熵能池中增加等同于那次d6掷骰结果的熵能点。若攻击失手，则你受到2d6 + 你智力调整值的伤害，同时在你的熵能池中减少等同于那次d6掷骰结果的熵能点。

**20级：随机威能 Random Spell**

⟦随机威能 Random Spell⟧

title: 犄角勇士 Horned Champion
body:
**犄角勇士 Horned Champion**
「别告诉我那些过分的担忧，告诉我世界的需要就好。」

**前提条件：守望者**

你曾大地之灵交流，发现了犄角勇士斗篷的价值。你超越了肉体，成为自然之灵的容器。你的职责是高举双臂，击倒大地的敌人，终止它们的毁灭行径，并重现那不羁的光彩。

变成一名犄角勇士是一种变形的体验。过去对世界天真的忧虑限制了你，现在你见识了世界的宏伟广阔，但也看到世界需要被保护，从那些可憎的试图吸取世界的力量的黑暗势力手中保护起来。你不再被人或环境所左右，专注于最重要的任务，对个别的困境不再投以注视。你对凡人的麻烦并不比你对一只昆虫更为关心，你所有的担忧投入了整个自然界中。因此某种程度上，你被一种比友谊还要深厚的感情所束缚，那就是被铸造来连接所有生命的纽带。

**11级：狠毒行动 Vicious Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行攻击且此攻击失手时，你能重掷此攻击骰，但必须使用第二次的结果。

**11级：热忱追捕 Fervent Pursuit**

**增益：**当你以借机攻击命中一个敌人时，该敌人迟缓直到它下一回合结束。

**11级：狂热打击 Zealous Strike**

⟦狂热打击 Zealous Strike⟧

**12级：迅疾步 Impetuous Stride**

⟦迅疾步 Impetuous Stride⟧

**16级：春天赐福 Blessing of Spring**

**增益：**当你使用有变形关键字的守望者每日攻击威能时，你能以一个自由动作花费一次回复力。

**20级：跳跃雄鹿化形 Form of the Leaping Stag**

⟦跳跃雄鹿化形 Form of the Leaping Stag⟧

title: 伽兰达圣所卫士 Ghallanda Sanctuary Guardian
prerequisite: ⟦款待之龙纹 <龙纹> Mark of Hospitality <Dragonmark>⟧专长
body:
**伽兰达圣所卫士 Ghallanda Sanctuary Guardian**
「我劝告你立即离开。不过其实，我的一部分十分乐于见到你不照做将会导致的事情。」

**前提条件：⟦款待之龙纹 <龙纹> Mark of Hospitality <Dragonmark>⟧专长**

做为一名圣所卫士，你是伽兰达家族的长矛尖端，擅长执行家族的授令，为宾客提供一个安全港。伽兰达家族遍布整个世界的领地都在被各种危害困扰着，例如不怀好意的地方当局，绑匪恶棍，以及狂冲乱撞的怪物。你已经受到了如何应付所有这些威胁的训练。通过你龙纹的力量，你为战斗打好了基础，以确保你的队友取得上风。你的威能帮助队友保持战意，使得敌人苦战。那些质疑你的人与你的同志很快将了解到，伽兰达家族有能力胜任使人舒适和便利之外的更多的领域。

**11级：迅速行动 Swift Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，离你5格内的每个盟友能以一个自由动作快步1格

**11级：热情洋溢 Hospitable Surge**

**增益：**当你花费一次回复力时，每个邻近你的盟友可以做一次豁免检定。这些盟友在此豁免检定上获得任何你在豁免检定上拥有的加值

**11级：驱散入侵者 Scatter the Invaders**

⟦驱散入侵者 Scatter the Invaders⟧

**12级：卫士之语 Guardian's Word**

⟦卫士之语 Guardian's Word⟧

**16级：伽兰达圣所 Ghallanda's Sanctuary**

**增益：**当任何离你5格内的盟友进行全防御或回气动作时，该盟友获得等同于5 + 你魅力调整值的临时生命值

21级时，此临时生命值为10 + 你魅力调整值

**20级：圣所打击 Sanctuary Strike**

⟦圣所打击 Sanctuary Strike⟧

title: 坚定骑士 Stalwart Knight
body:
**坚定骑士 Stalwart Knight**

**前提条件：战士（骑士）**

Your training and experience have made you strong, and the time has come to use that strength to advance your standing as a knight and a defender. Perhaps the time has come to join an order (if you have not done so already) or to establish your own. Either way, the stalwart knight stands at the forefront of every battle, a vanguard against the encroaching darkness.

**11级：坚定进攻 Stalwart Assault**

When the sound of battle calls, you answer with amazing strength and fury.

**增益：**在遭遇中你的第一回合内，你在速度和近战武器伤害骰上获得等同于你体质调整值的加值

**11级：坚定行动 Stalwart Action**

Strength of arm and a deep core of courage allow you to push beyond normal limits for a brief moment, at the same time focusing your defensive posture to keep you safe as that moment rushes by.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你获得全伤害抗力10直到你下一回合结束

**11级：进阶强力打击 Improved Power Strike**

You can make an additional devastating attack during any battle.

**增益：**你每场遭遇可再多使用一次⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧威能，但你仍然每回合只能使用一次

**12级：高级武器专精 Greater Weapon Specialization**

You have refined your fighting style, applying counterattacks and defensive tactics that allow you to prevail against even the strongest opponents.

**增益：**你选择获得下列遭遇威能中的1个

**剑刃防护 Shielding Blade**

When an enemy swings wide, you forego a quick counterstrike to take advantage of the error. By adopting a defensive posture, your blade becomes a shield against that foe as it tries in vain to strike again.

⟦剑刃防护 Shielding Blade⟧

**重锤反戈 Bludgeoning Counterstrike**

You have trained to take advantage of a foe's misstep, and when the enemy's attack goes wide, you are ready. The heft of your weapon lends deadly weight to your counterattacks.

⟦重锤反戈 Bludgeoning Counterstrike⟧

**16级：信念护甲 Armor of Conviction**

You refuse to flee the field of battle, no matter the danger. Instead, you have learned to steel yourself against pain when your defending presence is required.

**增益：**当你重伤时，你获得全伤害抗力5

**20级：战术专攻 Tactical Focus**

You add a tactical flare to your signature attack.

**增益：**当你使用⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧时，你可以滑动目标1格，或额外1格如果触发的威能已经滑动了目标

title: 坚定哨兵 Steadfast Sentinel
body:
**坚定哨兵 Steadfast Sentinel**

**前提条件：德鲁伊（哨兵）**

You are now a caretaker for the land as a whole, a guardian of the natural world against incursions from other planes. Using the magic of a thousand faces, you wander the land in many guises, your primal magic sustaining your allies and draining your foes.

**11级：进阶联合攻击 Improved Combined Attack**

With each battle you see through to the end, the signature combat move you practice with your animal companion becomes a more integral part of your tactics.

**增益：**你每场遭遇可再多使用一次⟦联合攻击 Combined Attack⟧威能，但你仍然每回合只能使用一次

**11级：哨兵行动 Sentinel's Action**

When you push beyond your limits, the primal magic you channel spills over to help your allies get back in the fight.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在此额外动作之前或之后，你或离你5格内的一个盟友能以一个自由动作以最多他的速度快步。此快步中，此角色无视困难地形

**11级：陆地行者 Landwalker**

As you follow the path of the steadfast sentinel, you become even more connected to the natural world. By sensing every rock, every crevasse, every gust of wind, every patch of brush and grass that surrounds you, you easily avoid such hindrances.

**增益：**你无视困难地形

**12级：春之恩惠 Bounty of Spring**

Your connection to the land draws you ever deeper into the everlasting cycle of growth and fulfillment that is the hallmark of all living things. By calling on the spirits of the land, you bind them and their revitalizing energy to your allies, letting those companions experience your connection to the world.

⟦春之恩惠 Bounty of Spring⟧

**16级：千面万相 A Thousand Faces**

When the primal spirits manifest, they take on an ever-changing array of forms and faces. By channeling their power, you gain a degree of this same mastery over your physical form.

⟦千面万相 A Thousand Faces⟧

**20级：翠绿和谐 Verdant Harmony**

At the apex of the paragon tier, you and your allies are embraced as kindred beings by the primal spirits of nature. Your foes become nature's foes, and they cannot shake off the wrath that the primal spirits bring to bear.

⟦翠绿和谐 Verdant Harmony⟧

title: 坚垒骑士 Knight of Unyielding Bastion
body:
**坚垒骑士 Knight of Unyielding Bastion**
//

**前提条件：圣武士**

作为一个王国与国民的守卫者，许多圣武士致力于对抗一种特殊的威胁，并在危急时刻挺身而出。作为一名坚垒骑士，你的技战术极为纯熟，并且掌握着一种神秘的祈祷——这使你在对抗巨龙时更加游刃有余。

**11级：屠龙挑战 Dragon's Challenge**

**增益：**当你使用⟦神圣挑战 Divine Challenge⟧标记一条龙时，它在目标不包括你的攻击骰上受到-4减值，而不是通常的-2。若一条龙因你的⟦神圣挑战 Divine Challenge⟧而受到伤害，则它受到等同于你感知调整值的额外伤害。

**11级：屠龙行动 Dragon-Slayer's Action**

title: 间谍大师 Master Spy
body:
**间谍大师 Master Spy**
「我见过那些你从未想我看到的，听过那些只对你的同谋者有意义的。我对你的了解足够毁掉你。」

**前提条件：游荡者**

In halls of power, on the field of battle, and even among those who seek what is long lost, reliable information is king. Those in the know have an advantage over their allies and enemies and readily know the difference between the two. Thus have persons skilled in acquiring secrets always had ample work and reasons to hone their skills. Such agents learn how to conceal their true motives and cover their tracks while focusing on attaining their goals. Any lapse in precision can mean death.

Long ago, you learned how to sneak into places where you're not welcome. No secret is safe from your expertise and trickery. Subterfuge is your stock-intrade. You know how best to peer into the intentions of your enemies, and you work undercover with the greatest of ease. Most of your enemies never know that you are in their midst, and you always manage to turn their ignorance against them.

你在轻刃与重刃上有着极高的造诣，所选择的武器已成为你力量与领导的象征。只要站立在战场之上，你手中便紧握着剑刃。而当盟友需要援助之时，只需找寻你那闪耀的武器。

title: 剑刃亡徒 Blade Bravo
body:
**剑刃亡徒 Blade Bravo**
「你觉得护甲能保护你？来这儿，让我们看看怎么回事儿。」

**前提条件：游荡者**

Most knaves are little more than ruffians who have a talent for swordplay. These individuals prowl city streets and pit their skills against each other, trying to prove themselves. Most of these so-called bravos have more courage than common sense. They have short life spans and usually wind up in shallow graves. You, however, have proved you're different from them.

You never had formal training or studied under a master. Instead, you developed a haphazard style born of necessity and emboldened by your grit. You quickly learned that survival demands toughness, so you cultivated the ability to keep scrapping even with your back pressed to the wall.

In battle, your attacks lack the finesse and artfulness exhibited by other rogues, yet they are equally effective. Just because you don't have a fancy flourish doesn't make you any less dangerous.

title: 剑湾海盗 Sword Coast Corsair
body:
**剑湾海盗 Sword Coast Corsair**
「从Luskan到Nelanther，没有我甩不掉的船，没有我杀不死的怪物。」

**前提条件：任意武术职业**

大海是如此的宽广无际，在陌生的彼岸有数不清的冒险在召唤着你。你总待是在船的瞭望台上，期待着一次惊心动魄的冒险或是数目惊人的宝藏。

无论前面有什么——海怪巢穴中失落的宝藏、幽灵作祟的船难遗址、邪恶领主的贮宝商船、或是终年被魔法云雾笼罩的小岛——你决心去一探究竟，并且凭你的智慧和勇气去解决那些拦住你去路的障碍。你只是想博出一番名声，管他是众人敬仰还是声名狼藉，只要在几百年后还能被人提起就够了。

尽管你是藏身于海上的铤而走险的海盗和凶残的掠夺者，但你并非是杀人不眨眼的凶手。比起抢劫穷苦，你更喜欢去打劫那些不义之财。剑岸是无比危险的，更何况你已经成为了所有社会民众的敌人。最好还是将那些诚实善良的人们置于你的保护之下。若你能驱使那些最凶狠的海盗为你而战，则金币都会是你的囊中之物。

**11级：老练水手 Expert Mariner**

**增益：**当你在船上时，你在先攻检定上获得+2加值，且你在任何有关移动，航行，操纵船只或躲避险境的技能上受训。若你已经在那个技能上受训，则你在这些检定上获得+2加值。举例包括：

杂技检定，用于在桅杆横杆和摇晃甲板上保持平衡

运动检定，用于攀爬船只的外壳和桅杆

智力检定，用于确定方位和绘制海图路线

敏捷检定，用于在危险水域中掌舵

如果你操纵载具，则所有能看到你或听到你的船员都获得这些加值。

**渐暗之刃 Darkening Blade**
「I am the dark of the new moon. My sword is the sharp crescent that heralds the doom you have earned.」

**前提条件：⟦薄暮精灵隐秘 <精灵血统> Dusk Elf Stealth <Elf Bloodline>⟧专长**

Gloaming guardians protect their communities fromintruders and occasional trespassers, but even thebarrier they create cannot catch all who prowl theirlands. Should their communities come under attack,the dusk elves flee, vowing vengeance on those whowrong them. The darkening blades embody the vengeance they swear and to them the dusk elves turn todestroy their enemies.

As a darkening blade, you have mastered a secretfighting style perfected through generations spent inexile. Shadows gather around you so that when youmove, you blend into them, making it hard for yourenemies to track your movements and attack you.When you strike, you do so with speed and accuracy,darting in, then melding into the gloom.

**箭矢指挥官 Arrowhead Commander**
「你在质疑我指挥的权利？先看看你能否拉开这张弓，然后我们才能聊聊。」

**前提条件：督军，⟦强弓学徒 <流派初成> Adamant Arrow Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长**

In combat after combat, you have proved that the arrow is among the deadliest of weapons. As you have grown as an archer, you have learned that a band of heroes is like an arrow. To be effective, it needs both a sharp head to guide it and a strong arm to set it in motion, both of which you provide.

Although you value mobility over heavy armor, your physical prowess means that you excel in melee. You try not to get lost in the thick of battle, because you might miss opportunities to bring your keen mind into play. You prefer to survey the battlefield with a glance and direct your allies to strike where an enemy force is weakest. If no such gap in your enemies' defenses exists, you unleash an arrow to create one.

**前提条件：角斗士主题或战士**

民众需要英雄的存在，他们需要英勇的战士去证明无论怎样艰险的困境都能被征服、他们需要目睹残酷的战斗来缓解他们对血腥的饥渴、他们需要一个敌方去发泄生活中的挫败与怒火——他们需要角斗士，需要那些无畏的战士为他们带来一场又一场的欢愉。

你正是人民所需要的角斗冠军，你或许有一个苦大仇深的背景，你可能曾是一个奴隶或者罪犯，亦或你是一个来这里找点乐子、赚点小钱、赢得荣誉的资深战士。无论如何，你和你的勇气引起了民众的共鸣，你不再是一个只是为了自己生命而战的战士，你是他们的英雄。

**狡黠诈徒 Cunning Prevaricator**
「穿梭于世界之间的妖精有句谚语：唯有不诚实，才能赢得荣誉。」

**前提条件：诗人**

精类骗子、侏儒或是其他讲故事的人都知道许多其他生物所不知晓的传说——来自僻静的森林，地下深处的洞穴，强大野兽的巢穴或是某位君主紧锁的神秘地窖。而不为世人所知的是，这些传说中很有多都仅仅是编造出来的谎言。

作为一个狡黠诈徒，你传播夸大、误导和谎言的美德（至少某些传统中确实认为这是美德）。你学习并遵循过去伟大寓言家的教导（虽然这些寓言家也是被编造出来的）并将这些知识应用到你的诗人技能之中。你将幻觉和欺骗方面的天赋用于你的朋友，给他们带来荣耀，或是用谎言让他们相信自己得到了荣耀。

title: 解构者 Anathema
body:
**解构者 Anathema**
「Why create when destruction is so much more entertaining?」

**前提条件：心灵术士**

Others of your kind shape reality as a potter works clay, but creating and reforming your environment has little appeal to you. Instead, your knowledge of the underlying patterns in the structure of the objects and creatures that make up the world around you that allows you to test and sunder that structure.

The raw stuff of life and matter are yours to toy with. Your power comes at a price, however. With each bond you break, the structure of reality is weakened to some small degree. Your work is minor compared to the ravages of time and the power of gods, immortals, and the Far Realm. But all things are connected, and your power might be the catalyst that unleashes destruction on the world.

body:
**界门守卫 Guardian of the Living Gate**
「有一些不属于这个世界的生物想要毁灭我们所建立的一切，我的使命就是先将他们毁灭。」

**前提条件：德鲁伊**

远古的契约与法则保护自然世界不会受到神祗和魔神的严重干扰。虽然魔神和恶魔很想把这个世界给弄回元素混沌，但他们的力量受到了限制。在很多德鲁伊眼中，目前世界所面临的最大威胁不是神祗或者魔神，而是那些来自遥远国度，不受远古法则制约的外来生物。这些生物不一定都想毁灭这个世界，但无论目的是什么，他们的存在本身就危及了这个世界。

作为一位界门守卫，你誓言清除所有和遥远国度有关的异常生物，并且切断两个世界之间传送门。你可能已经加入了其他志同道合者的组织（其中真实之环the Circle of the True是最大的一个）。或者还在独自一人探寻界门(Living Gate)的神秘知识。从第一阶守护开始，这一道途上，你可以掌握神秘之力。这些力量在保护伙伴，摧毁敌人方面是通常很有用的，但你务必要使用它们抵御那些想腐化和摧毁这个世界的势力。

You exemplify the virtues of Erathis. In life, you abide by and enforce the laws of your people. title: 尽头旅者 Horizon Walker
body:
**尽头旅者 Horizon Walker**
「时光流逝，而我终将以双眼见证诸界。」

**前提条件：游侠**

The world is vast, with few mapped places. It begs exploration, instilling wanderlust in brave hearts. Roving it is a test of skill and stamina, an ordeal that rewards the intrepid with amazing sights, exciting encounters, and more. Still, the world is only one place in the broader cosmos. Other planes also beckon to the curious wanderer. The trials and experiences they offer can defy the worldly imagination and force adaptation beyond mortal ken.

Horizon walker is the traditional name for a ceaseless roamer who seeks the unexplored regions of the universe. The appellation applies to members of a loose confederation of warriors who recognize one another as comrades on life's wondrous journey. Such travelers go from place to place, from plane to plane, developing their skills and a mystic connection with the environment. They return changed by their contact with other realms, and with knowledge to better protect the world most mortals know.

Like most horizon walkers, you have traveled the world. You learned about it and protect its inhabitants from otherworldly threats. Then you fearlessly set out into the wider universe, using your skills and the magical nature of your tie to the world to develop similar bonds with the far reaches of creation. To this day, you're incapable of staying in one place long. Unseen locales summon you with their mystery. Your destiny whispers to you from an unknown vista. Each step you take moves you closer to it.

title: 精金导师 Adamant Instructor
body:
**精金导师 Adamant Instructor**
「It is my destiny to unite the Great Teacher's peoples once again.」

**前提条件：龙裔，任意神术职业**

The Great Teacher was revered by all the peoples of his underground realm. The ancient adamantine dragon's influence didn't spread into the land of sun and wind, but in the rock, ore, and fungus of the Underdark, his benevolence erected an island of good under the earth. Long ago, the Great Teacher rescued a group of dragonborn that that were beset by denizens of the Underdark, and instead of returning to the surface, these dragonborn devoted themselves to the Adamantine. They became his Adamant Instructors and together they forged a noble nation around the Great Teacher's hoard in the cavern complex they called Adamanth. The dragonborn prospered under the Teacher's guidance, and Adamanth became a haven for all that was good and strong. Even some drow and duergar were drawn by the Great Teacher's benevolence to renounce their darker ways and live in peace under the rule of the Adamant Instructors.

Then one day the Great Teacher departed Adamanth to deal with a nasty group of purple dragons that were slaughtering his people on the borders of his influence. He never returned. For decades, the Adamant Instructors have followed the Great Teacher's instructions, which were carved on a disk of solid adamantine in flowing draconic script by the ancient dragon before he departed. But the Adamant Instructors are hard-pressed to keep hope alive in Adamanth. Purple worms continue to assail them, the drow are assembling an army, and rumors say that mind flayers are stirring in the deep caves to the west. In the absence of the Great Teacher, it is up to the Adamant Instructors to lead the adamantine dragon's people through these dark times.
